name: uncalibrated interchange arrival cadence and gate schedule
description: inspect how explicitly authored deterministic arrival cadence, pulse size, and a timed gate-service reduction affect one constrained interchange configuration

factors.subject: passengers
factors.rationale: The 0.5 s, 1 s, and 2 s intervals expose deterministic demand-timing sensitivity without claiming an observed arrival process.

factors.subject: passengers
factors.rationale: The one-, four-, and eight-person pulses expose deterministic arrival-pulse sensitivity without claiming an observed demand distribution.

factors.subject: fare_gate_reduced
factors.rationale: The 0.5/s, 0.75/s, and 1.0/s post-change gate limits expose an explicitly authored operational stress schedule without claiming observed staffing or equipment performance.

factors.subject: fare_gate_reduced
factors.rationale: The 20 s, 30 s, and 40 s transition times expose deterministic timing sensitivity without claiming an observed shift, incident, equipment state, or operational response.

claim_boundary: This deterministic sensitivity study explores declared staged-demand and service-limit schedules. It does not estimate an arrival distribution, passenger demand, observed staffing, equipment reliability, station performance, operational suitability, or safety outcome.
